text: I had the absolute displeasure of visiting The Rusty Spoon last night, and it was undoubtedly the worst dining experience I've had in years. To be fair, the downtown location is fantastic, and the interior decor is actually quite charming. But that is exactly where the positives end. The service was completely abysmal. We waited for over 45 minutes just to get a glass of water, and our waiter had the audacity to roll his eyes when we finally asked for the menu. When the food arrived—after a staggering two-hour wait—it was cold and completely flavorless. I ordered a medium-rare steak, but what I received was a tough, overcooked piece of charcoal that even a stray dog wouldn't chew. The pasta my wife ordered wasn't just bland; it was actively disgusting and swimming in a pool of grease. To top it all off, the bill was outrageously expensive. If you enjoy throwing your hard-earned money in the garbage while being treated like an absolute nuisance by the staff, then this is the perfect establishment for you. I will never be returning here, and I highly recommend avoiding this place like the plague
